title: pisum sativum var. pumilio
intro: Pisum sativum var. pumilio, commonly known as the miniature garden pea, is a compact, dwarf variety of the common pea (Pisum sativum). The miniature garden pea has been traditionally used for its nutritional value and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pisum sativum var. pumilio include its high content of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, which may help reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of the miniature garden pea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
